summary: Trousdale County, TN state tower 4-26; listed as standing in 2014 and by Tennessee Landforms; no build date or staffing found; searches often surface an unrelated TVA cooling tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Searches also return a Hartsville tower in Darlington County, South Carolina (the Forest Lookouts page at /hartsville.html) and a TVA cooling tower in Hartsville. This record uses only the Trousdale County lookout, which Tennessee Landforms and the Tennessee index support.

notes_for_editor: Do not cite easternuslookouts.weebly.com/hartsville.html: it describes a Hartsville tower in Darlington County, South Carolina, not this Tennessee lookout. The TVA cooling tower is a separate structure. Only tnlandforms, the Forest Lookouts Tennessee index and the 2014 extant table support this record. Nothing found on build date, design, staffing, fires or current condition. The tower is not on the NHLR Tennessee list in the crawl.
